lede: Washington Commanders carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#14 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#13 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders −1.0 with a fair total of 42.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits −0.088 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
